decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch with sound builds on the firm's established arch, candleholder, and decoration skills, allowing it to absorb feedback and refine the product.
The arched one-tier Christmas pyramid leverages existing pyramid construction and carving expertise, enabling interpretation of results and incremental improvement.

The electronic music box with interchangeable discs remains distant from the firm's woodcraft knowledge and, with limited in-house R&D and university cooperation, the firm cannot assimilate or improve it.
The Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid draws directly on the firm's established pyramid and painting skills, supporting absorption of feedback and refinement.
